text:
The Tundra planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover six modules: pricing, returns, tenant, sync, backup, and shipping.

Key requirements:
- Sync must precede backup in rollout. mapper.py lives under sync, and models.py lives under returns.
- Only delta can take backup, and it owns pricing.
- pricing and returns share a worker. returns depends on pricing and tenant, and no dependency path may run from returns to sync.
- Backup and shipping never share a worker (audit requirement).
- sync batch_size is 600. When it exceeds 450, shipping ttl_s must be at least 570.
- pricing queue_depth is 370 (corrected). When it exceeds 340, shipping max_workers must be at least 32.
- returns retry_limit is 7 (corrected). tenant queue_depth must be exactly 490.

Open items: the security review is at month-end, the budget review is next Thursday, Ken is catching up on documentation, and the shared metrics library and linter decisions are parked.
